solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Amar Bank's workload.

data_flow: Customer documents, metadata, and related business records are stored in MongoDB Atlas and made available to search, audit, or user-facing workflows.
business_outcome: Delivering hundreds of millions of dollars to Indonesian economy
metrics: THE RESULTS Delivering hundreds of millions of dollars to Indonesian economy Since its establishment in 2014, Amar Bank has gone from strength to strength.
As a result of making credit accessible to more people, Amar Bank disbursed USD $537 million (IDR8 trillion) in small loans to more than 575,000 customers in 2022.
This resulted in a huge increase in revenue in seven years – from USD $1.07 million annually to USD $48.5 million.
architecture_clues: The deployment uses a multi-cloud strategy.
The deployment integrates with Google Cloud.
